summary.headline: Mars Combustion in Three Signs
summary.text: Astrological judgments for the combustion of Mars in Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces, including forecasts of weather, disease, warfare, political disorder, crop and animal damage, prices, and the effects of conjunctions or aspects with Saturn, Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, and the Moon.
